proposal.reason: Main change is contribution/review/merge automation: new `/merge` command workflow, multi-commit squash-message generation/publishing scripts and skill, reviewer-routing Copilot installer refactor, and contribution policy/docs updates. Although `pr-test-ppu.yml` is edited, those trigger/concurrency/gate changes are supporting wiring for review/merge automation while normal test execution semantics are intentionally preserved, so a separate `ci` module is not independently required.
